2027.note: 2026-27 realignment, effective July 1 2026. `from` is the season-2026 conference and is verified against the DB at load time, so a re-ingest that moves a team out from under an entry is caught instead of silently overriding. Sources: CBS Sports 'College basketball conference changes: Takeaways after 27 teams move to new leagues for 2026-27'; Wikipedia '2026-27 NCAA Division I men's basketball season' membership-changes table; pac-12.com 'The new Pac-12 Conference officially launches with the addition of seven full-time members' (2026-06-30); acusports.com 'WAC to Rebrand to UAC, Add Five New Members in 2026-27'.

moves.note: Not a move — the WAC rebranded as the United Athletic Conference on 2026-07-01. Recorded so the label follows the league.

left_division_i.note: Saint Francis (PA) is reclassifying to Division III and joining the Presidents' Athletic Conference; 2025-26 was its last Division I season. Projecting it would put a team on the board that no longer plays in the division.

new_division_i.note: Informational only, not applied. West Florida moves up from Division II (Gulf South) into the ASUN and has no prior Division I season, so it has no roster to project and cannot appear on this page. Recorded here so the realignment record is complete.
